item_name: Rothco Mesh Back Thin Red Line Tactical Cap
item_short_desc: Breathable & Moisture Wicking; Rothco's Mesh Back Tactical Cap has been designed to keep you cool under pressure. The tactical cap also features an embroidered Thin Red Line Flag. Show your pride for firefighters with this knit watch cap embroidered with the thin red line flag.
